Beginning with the November 2008 election, Richmond City Council terms were lengthened to 4 years. The Richmond city council meets at City Hall. Richmond City Hall is located at 900 E. Broad St., 2nd Floor. The Richmond city council elects one member from among its members to serve as Council President. The Richmond city council has representatives from nine districts. Citizens in each of the nine districts of Richmond elect one council representative each. The Richmond city government consists of a city council. The Richmond city government has a popularly elected, at-large mayor. The Richmond city council elects one member from among its members to serve as Council Vice President. The popularly elected, at-large mayor of Richmond serves as head of the executive branch. The Richmond city council does not meet in August. Each council representative in Richmond serves a four-year term. The representatives from the nine districts in the Richmond city council serve in a legislative and oversight capacity.

retrieved_chunks_summary.chunk_summary: This chunk contains information about the population statistics and rankings of Tucson, its metropolitan area, and combined statistical area based on census data and estimates.
retrieved_chunks_summary.page_content: The 2013 estimated population of the entire Tucson metropolitan statistical area (MSA) was 996,544. The 2010 United States Census put the population of Tucson at 520,116. Tucson is the second-largest populated city in Arizona behind Phoenix. Tucson is the 33rd largest city in the United States. Tucson is the 59th largest metropolitan area in the United States. The Tucson MSA forms part of the larger Tucson-Nogales combined statistical area (CSA). The Tucson-Nogales combined statistical area (CSA) had a total population of 980,263 as of the 2010 Census.
